title: Legacy of Goku II Enhanced
description: A rebalance of The Legacy of Goku II, made for the European ROM. Levelling is much faster after level 30, every character starts with a large ki bonus so special moves and Super Saiyan are usable, and the characters are re-tuned: Gohan starts weak and ends strongest, Vegeta, Piccolo and Trunks each excel in one stat, and Goku is above average in all. A second patch includes an anti-piracy fix for flash carts.
